description: Microsoft Edge is a cross-platform web browser developed by Microsoft.
notes:
The Kasm Edge Workspace requires "seccomp=unconfined" to function properly.

This can be run in an unsecure manner by adding: {"security_opt":["seccomp=unconfined"]} to the Docker Run Config Override (JSON) setting above.

NOTE: This will run the Workspace without the docker seccomp sandbox and will significantly reduce the amount of protection that Kasm Workspaces can provide.
